readerLayoutSeen.how: raster_window.py and point_batch.py run locally (venv-vision, no Docker) on the three kept NYC originals; artifacts written to a scratch folder outside Git, tags dumped
readerLayoutSeen.raster: classic little-endian TIFF, one strip IFD (RowsPerStrip 8 or 32), Compression 8 (zlib deflate), Predictor 1, PlanarConfiguration 1; ortho 4 x uint8, Photometric RGB, ExtraSamples 2 (unassociated alpha); DEM 1 x float32 (SampleFormat 3), GDAL_NODATA tag; second IFD = internal mask (NewSubfileType 4, 1 bit, deflate)
readerLayoutSeen.points: raw LAS 1.4 format 6 records, 30 bytes each, no header; X, Y, Z int32 at bytes 0, 4, 8

files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/tif: bounded decoder of the reader's own TIFF layout (strips, none or deflate through the browser's DecompressionStream, chunky, predictor 1, mask IFD); refuses tiled, other compressions, BigTIFF and over-bound sizes with words
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/pix: RGB/RGBA as written; one band shaded grey by the part's own min and max; nodata, NaN and mask-0 pixels transparent
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/las: format-6 records (at most 8,192) to flat points at their placed XY (bilinear from the batch's native extent to its placed corners), coloured by Z rank
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/par: part paging, display reads at most 4 in flight, 256 drawn per item, item lines in words
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/use: cases of the area's site, intake manifest, batch stream refresh, engine hook
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/surface/Sur: item lines for the windowed area
files.packages/scene/src/engine.ts, types.ts: additive setSurfaceParts: parts added and removed by id in their own group, so a new part never rebuilds the others
files.apps/studio/src/features/map/MapWorkspac: mount the layer and its layer-list lines

reuse: existing raster-windows and point-batches artifact routes
GET /api/v1/cases siteId -> the area's site, as batchAreaTx joins it
scene overlay drawing style (ground picture order, alpha cutout, Points)
decisions: The reader writes deflate strips, so the decoder reads compression 1 and 8 (zlib) and refuses every other compression and any tiled layout with words; refusing all compression would refuse every real part.
A fourth band is drawn as alpha only when ExtraSamples marks it alpha (the NYC ortho does); otherwise RGB is drawn opaque and the line says the fourth band is not drawn.
Multi-band rasters other than uint8 and two-band rasters are refused with words; the outline is still drawn.
notRun: Step 0 plan only; no runtime, Docker, GPU or provider call.
